rows.quote: We screened 2408 phenotypes from 44 categories in the Finnish database (R10 version), which comprised 412,181 individuals.
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the Finnish database R10 version comprising 412,181 individuals: the release label and the exact sample size of one row.
The data-source table lists several UK Biobank GWAS under different accessions and sample sizes, some with FinnGen; the name identifies no single dictionary row.
